name: Disa the Restless
oracle_text:
Whenever a Lhurgoyf permanent card is put into your graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, put it onto the battlefield.
Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, create a Tarmogoyf token.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a Lhurgoyf permanent card is put into your graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, put it onto the battlefield.
Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, create a Tarmogoyf token.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires when a card matching a filter (here: a permanent card with subtype Lhurgoyf, owner = you) is put into a graveyard, narrowed by `from_zones` to every zone except the battlefield (hand via discard, library via mill/surveil, stack via countered/resolved, exile), binding the moved card as the subject so the effect can `put_onto_battlefield` exactly that card ("put it") if it is still in the graveyard on resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no zone-change-to-graveyard event: leaves_battlefield/dies only see permanents leaving the battlefield (exactly the source this card excludes), discard covers only the hand, leaves_graveyard is the reverse direction, and the trigger's from_zones key is read only for spell_cast and land_played. Without the event there is also no binding for 'it'.

needs.what: a Tarmogoyf token: a */1+* green Lhurgoyf creature token whose power is the number of card types among cards in all graveyards and whose toughness is that number plus 1
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Tarmogoyf (or any */1+* Lhurgoyf) token, and the closed list cannot be substituted with a nearby token. The trigger itself (creatures_deal_combat_damage, batched, controller you, then create_token) is expressible once the token exists.
